description: Check a token on BNB Smart Chain, Ethereum, Base or Arc for traps before buying it. ChainK9 forks the chain and really buys and sells the token in a sandbox, then runs 70+ checks: honeypot, hidden and changing buy and sell taxes, owner pause, blacklist, mint and confiscation powers, transfer and sell limits, cooldowns, liquidity, upgrade authority. It trades the token's deepest funded market: a pool on one of the chain's exchanges (PancakeSwap V2, V3 and Infinity CL, Uniswap V2, V3 and V4 with its hook, Aerodrome and others) against the native coin or against another coin traded through that coin's own pool, or a four.meme or Flap bonding curve; on Arc, its V4 pool against USDC. Returns a verdict (danger, caution, ok) and every check's result. Results are reused for 10 minutes. Not charged when the address isn't a token or has no liquidity yet (422). Costs $0.02 per successful call in USDC on Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, BNB Smart Chain (USDT) or Solana, paid with x402 in the call's _meta; failed calls are free.
